scope: Query processing, aggregation, selection, context building and generation after a shared rehydrated retrieval pool. Chunk scores rounded as logged. SQL searches, embeddings and provider transports/fallbacks excluded.
code_revision: Working tree after 534ef86; source fingerprint and archived source files identify the exact checked code.

result.offline_replay: Both engines; TCP/DNS and sync/async PostgreSQL connects denied. Local read-only preparation happened before the offline phase.

discovered_difference.cause: Legacy ORDER BY priority alone leaves ties unspecified; core also orders by acronym with C collation and id.
discovered_difference.fix: Use the same priority/acronym/id ordering, including schemas without priority, in the legacy loader.
discovered_difference.scope: A real input difference, not proof that it caused the prior quality gap.

limits: The retrieval output pool is rehydrated with logged rounded chunk scores; original raw SQL lanes and embedding vectors were not retained.
The frozen reranking outcomes and model texts are dependency inputs; provider transport failures and q222 fallback routing are not replayed.
This proves exact engine parity only for the recorded shared inputs and the stated boundary. It does not prove live-model determinism or judge reliability.
The previous live scores (60/98 core, 62/98 legacy) are preserved; the acronym-order fix has not been remeasured with new provider calls.
